name: Six months free
role: Days 151-180: light weekly maintenance, mentorship, graduation from the guided plan
days[0].title: Day 151: Welcome to the final chapter
days[0].intro: The last chapter of your guided plan. The daily load gets lighter from here because the goal is maintenance, not construction. The trap is behind you; this month is about walking away from it without looking back.
days[0].tasks[0].title: How this chapter works
days[0].tasks[0].text: Chapter seven uses a light weekly focus instead of dense daily tasks, since the heavy lifting of quitting is behind you.
days[0].tasks[1].title: Set your graduation goal
days[0].tasks[1].text: Pick one thing you want to be true about your relationship with smoking by graduation day.
days[1].title: Day 152: This week's focus, routine check
days[1].intro: A simple check on whether your replacement routines are still solid.
days[1].tasks[0].title: Review your core routines
days[1].tasks[0].text: Write down your current morning and evening routines and whether they still feel automatic.
days[2].title: Day 153: Twenty three weeks free
days[2].intro: Almost five and a half months.
days[2].tasks[0].title: Claim your twenty three week badge
days[2].tasks[0].text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.
days[3].title: Day 154: Quick craving check
days[3].intro: A simple pulse check on where cravings stand now.
days[3].tasks[0].title: Rate this week's cravings
days[3].tasks[0].text: Rate how often, if at all, you noticed a craving this week.
days[4].title: Day 155: Community check-in
days[4].intro: Staying lightly connected helps even after daily missions ease up.
days[4].tasks[0].title: Check the community
days[4].tasks[0].text: Spend a couple of minutes in the community today, reading or replying.
days[5].title: Day 156: Money milestone glance
days[5].intro: A quick look at how much your saved money has grown.
days[5].tasks[0].title: See your savings
days[5].tasks[0].text: Open your money saved tab and look at your current total, now free of both cigarette and NRT costs.
days[6].title: Day 157: Twenty four weeks free
days[6].intro: Twenty four weeks, a clean half-year count by weeks alone.
days[6].tasks[0].title: Claim your twenty four week badge
days[6].tasks[0].text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.
days[7].title: Day 158: This week's focus, trigger scan
days[7].intro: A light check on whether any old trigger has quietly resurfaced.
days[7].tasks[0].title: Scan for resurfacing triggers
days[7].tasks[0].text: Write whether any old trigger has felt slightly stronger lately, even faintly.
days[8].title: Day 159: Health glance
days[8].intro: A quick look at how your health progress keeps building.
days[8].tasks[0].title: See your health overview
days[8].tasks[0].text: Open your health progress tab and notice the continued improvement since chapter five.
days[9].title: Day 160: One hundred sixty days
days[9].intro: Twenty days remain until you graduate the guided plan entirely.
days[9].tasks[0].title: Claim your one hundred sixty day badge
days[9].tasks[0].text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.
days[9].tasks[1].title: Rate how maintenance feels
days[9].tasks[1].text: Rate how natural staying smoke free feels now compared to needing daily structure.
days[10].title: Day 161: This week's focus, gratitude
days[10].intro: Notice what quitting has given you, not just what it took away.
days[10].tasks[0].title: One thing you are grateful for
days[10].tasks[0].text: Write one specific thing about quitting that you are genuinely grateful for.
days[11].title: Day 162: Twenty five weeks free
days[11].intro: The numbers keep climbing quietly in the background of your normal life.
days[11].tasks[0].title: Claim your twenty five week badge
days[11].tasks[0].text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.
days[12].title: Day 163: Mentorship check
days[12].intro: Keep supporting others as you near graduation. It cements your own freedom.
days[12].tasks[0].title: Help one newer member
days[12].tasks[0].text: Find one person earlier in their journey and offer encouragement or a specific tip.
days[13].title: Day 164: This week's focus, identity
days[13].intro: A quick reminder of how far your sense of self has traveled since day one.
days[13].tasks[0].title: Describe yourself in one line
days[13].tasks[0].text: Write one line describing how you see yourself now in relation to smoking.
days[14].title: Day 165: Twenty six weeks free
days[14].intro: Twenty six weeks, exactly half a year by the week count.
days[14].tasks[0].title: Claim your twenty six week badge
days[14].tasks[0].text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.
days[14].tasks[1].title: Half year stats
days[14].tasks[1].text: Open your stats and review your full progress at the half year mark by weeks.
days[15].title: Day 166: Stats glance
days[15].intro: A quick look at the full numbers as graduation approaches.
days[15].tasks[0].title: Review your full stats
days[15].tasks[0].text: Open your stats tab and look across streak, money saved and cigarettes avoided.
days[16].title: Day 167: This week's focus, life after the plan
days[16].intro: Think about life as a permanent non smoker beyond the app's guided structure.
days[16].tasks[0].title: Picture life after graduation
days[16].tasks[0].text: Write a few sentences about how you want to maintain your smoke free life once the guided plan ends: which habits stay, which check-ins continue, who you keep supporting.
days[17].title: Day 168: Twelve days to graduation
days[17].intro: Twelve days remain until you complete the full guided plan and reach six months.
days[17].tasks[0].title: Claim your one hundred sixty eight day badge
days[17].tasks[0].text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.
days[18].title: Day 169: Quick check-in
days[18].intro: A simple pulse check as the final stretch begins.
days[18].tasks[0].title: Rate your graduation readiness
days[18].tasks[0].text: Rate how ready you feel to move beyond the structured daily plan.
days[19].title: Day 170: This week's focus, full circle
days[19].intro: A reflective look back at the entire plan you are about to complete.
days[19].tasks[0].title: Full circle reflection
days[19].tasks[0].text: Write a few sentences reflecting on the road from day one to day one hundred seventy.
days[20].title: Day 171: Nine days left
days[20].intro: Nine days until you graduate and hit six months.
days[20].tasks[0].title: See how close you are
days[20].tasks[0].text: Open your stats and look at how close you are to the six month milestone.
days[21].title: Day 172: Community thank you
days[21].intro: Acknowledge the people who supported you along the way.
days[21].tasks[0].title: Thank someone
days[21].tasks[0].text: Send a thank you message to anyone in the community who helped you on your journey.
days[22].title: Day 173: Seven days left
days[22].intro: One week remains until you complete the full guided plan.
days[22].tasks[0].title: Rate final week confidence
days[22].tasks[0].text: Rate how confident you feel heading into your final week.
days[23].title: Day 174: Planning your graduation
days[23].intro: Six days remain. Decide how you will mark finishing the entire plan.
days[23].tasks[0].title: Plan the celebration
days[23].tasks[0].text: Decide how you want to celebrate six months and graduation in six days, ideally funded entirely by money you did not burn.
days[24].title: Day 175: Five days left
days[24].intro: A short reflective prompt as the finish line nears.
days[24].tasks[0].title: What graduation means
days[24].tasks[0].text: Write a few sentences about what completing this entire guided plan means to you.
days[25].title: Day 176: Four days left
days[25].intro: Four days until every chapter of the guided plan is complete.
days[25].tasks[0].title: Look back at chapter one
days[25].tasks[0].text: Open your history from chapter one and notice how different that version of you felt compared to now.
days[26].title: Day 177: Three days left
days[26].intro: Almost every milestone in the plan now sits behind you.
days[26].tasks[0].title: Rate the full plan
days[26].tasks[0].text: Rate your overall experience of the guided plan from day one to now.
days[27].title: Day 178: Two days left
days[27].intro: Soon you officially graduate from structured daily missions.
days[27].tasks[0].title: A note for future you
days[27].tasks[0].text: Write a short note to read on any hard day after graduation, reminding yourself why you quit, that cravings are echoes, and that there is no such thing as just one.
days[28].title: Day 179: One day left
days[28].intro: Tomorrow: six full months smoke free and the official end of your guided plan.
days[28].tasks[0].title: One last look back
days[28].tasks[0].text: Open your full stats and scroll through your entire journey from day one to today.
days[28].tasks[1].title: Tonight's reflection
days[28].tasks[1].text: Write one sentence about how you feel the night before reaching six months.
days[29].title: Day 180: Six months free, plan complete
days[29].intro: One hundred and eighty days. Six full months without a single cigarette, nicotine free, and the complete guided plan finished from start to end. You did not give something up; you got yourself back. Every tool stays in your pocket for life, but you walk out of here as what you now simply are: a non smoker.
days[29].tasks[0].title: Claim your six month badge
days[29].tasks[0].text: Open your badges tab and collect this major milestone, the biggest one in the guided plan.
days[29].tasks[1].title: Your full six month transformation
days[29].tasks[1].text: Open your full stats and health overview to see the entire journey across all six months and every chapter.
days[29].tasks[2].title: Write your graduation letter
days[29].tasks[2].text: Write a letter to your day one self, telling them everything that happened between day one and day one hundred eighty.
days[29].tasks[3].title: Share your graduation
days[29].tasks[3].text: Post in the community that you completed the full guided plan and reached six months smoke free.
